verdict.rationale: Convex ships an official CLI (npx convex) documented in depth with commands like run, import, insights, and dev-mode file watching, and hands-on probe evidence confirms it installs and runs headlessly (version 1.45.0). It's also explicitly positioned for agentic/AI-native workflows via the paired MCP server and agent-setup docs. Missing for 10: independent third-party review of CLI robustness beyond first-party docs and a single probe run.
